City of Laguna Niguel 2021-2029 Housing Element, Table IV-3, Residential Development Standards, sourced there to the Laguna Niguel Zoning Ordinance: Single Family 3 (RS-3). — Laguna Niguel's Zoning Ordinance states NO maximum density for any residential district. City of Newport Beach Zoning Code, Title 20, Chapter 20.18 (Residential Zoning Districts), Tables 2-2 and 2-3, adopted October 26, 2010: Two Unit Residential (R-2). — Chapter 20.18 states this district's capacity as a minimum site area per dwelling unit rather than as a density, and its floor area limit against buildable area rather than lot area, so what is published here is a unit count and no floor area ratio. City of Newport Beach Zoning Code, Title 20, Chapter 20.18 (Residential Zoning Districts), Tables 2-2 and 2-3, adopted October 26, 2010: Two Unit Residential (R-2). — Chapter 20.18 states this district's capacity as a minimum site area per dwelling unit rather than as a density, and its floor area limit against buildable area rather than lot area, so what is published here is a unit count and no floor area ratio. Table 2-3 states this district's capacity as a minimum site area of 1,000 sq ft per dwelling unit measured against the NET area of the lot, so the unit count here is this parcel's own lot area divided by that figure. Table 2-3 caps these two-unit districts at “no more than 2 units per lot” regardless of lot area, and that cap -- not the site area per unit -- is what binds here. It therefore cannot be applied to this parcel's recorded lot area and no floor area is computed from it here. The buildable floor area and unit capacity here are therefore the figures for that shared lot, not for this parcel on its own.
